title: Materials Project Schema
description: JSON schema for Materials Project API summary endpoint response

run_id.description: Unique identifier for the calculation run

database_version.description: Version of the Materials Project database

build_date.description: Date when the calculation was performed

nsites.description: Number of sites in the structure

elements.description: List of chemical elements in the material

composition.description: Chemical composition as element: count mapping

volume.description: Unit cell volume in cubic Angstroms

deprecated.description: Whether this material entry is deprecated

uncorrected_energy_per_atom.description: Uncorrected energy per atom in eV

formation_energy_per_atom.description: Formation energy per atom in eV

energy_above_hull.description: Energy above convex hull in eV

is_stable.description: Whether the material is thermodynamically stable

equilibrium_reaction_energy_per_atom.description: Equilibrium reaction energy per atom in eV

edge.description: XAS edge type (K, L, M, etc.)

spectrum_type.description: Type of XAS spectrum (XANES, EXAFS, XAFS)

is_gap_direct.description: Whether the band gap is direct

es_source_calc_id.description: Source calculation ID for electronic structure

dos_energy_up.description: Density of states for spin up

dos_energy_down.description: Density of states for spin down

theoretical.description: Whether this is a theoretical material
